evals.prompt: Design the locations for my script: a flooded subway station and the maintenance office above it.
evals.expected_output: Two location records with floor plans, landmarks, exits, light sources and identity locks, plus plate specs.
expectations: Each location has a 'record: location' with landmarks and light_sources
Each location has a text floor plan with exits marked
Identity locks contain no lighting or weather words
Plate specifications name camera position and time of day

evals.prompt: List the props for this scene: a woman finds a letter, burns it, and keeps the envelope.
evals.expected_output: Prop records with every state change (sealed, opened, burning, ashes; envelope kept) and the scene each starts.
expectations: A prop record exists for the letter with multiple states such as sealed/opened/burnt
Each state has the scene or shot where it begins
The envelope is a separate prop record or a clearly separate state track
State IDs use the PROP:STATE format

evals.prompt: The street in my film needs a neon sign with the shop name readable in every shot.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the sign but flags readable text as an AI risk for VFX and keeps the text minimal.
expectations: The readable text is flagged for vfx-supervisor or post insertion
The response keeps the sign text short
No real trademark or brand name is used
